homonyms.basis: No card is a homonym, and T composes no other entity under the name: the capture's reached kind is 'same'. 'CELL' alone is a common word and an acronym of many other things (biology, telephony, other consortia); the address carries the full name, and the composition answers for the consortium. The census's other names for it are 'CELL', 'The Index of Electronic Literature' and 'Consortium on Electronic Literature'; ebr writes 'Consortium for Electronic Literature (CELL)'. The distinct entities below are named by the field, the census or the archive beside the entity and are never senses of its name.
distinct_entities: ELMCIP, the Electronic Literature Knowledge Base (University of Bergen), CELL's first listed member, frozen since October 2026 (B4; its own census row, elmcip)
the Electronic Literature Directory (ELD) and the Electronic Literature Organization (ELO), its member database and its initiator and partner (its census rows elc for the Collection; the ELO)
NT2, PO.EX, ADEL, Ciberia and DLD, the other member archives, each an institution of its own
the Center for Digital Narrative, University of Bergen, its host and director (B2 F14)
the Electronic Literature Lab and The NEXT, partners and collaborators named by Wikipedia (their own /non rows)
electronic book review (its own census row, ebr), which lists CELL among its affiliations
the Digital Narrative Knowledge Base, ELMCIP's successor (B4 F50)
Wikidata, the hub of the Index (its own /non row)

captures.description: THE CONSORTIUM, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Consortium on Electronic Literature (CELL) is an international, open-access collaboration that provides centralized access to digital literary databases, archives, and institutional repositories.' Pointers to 'The Index | CELL' and 'About CELL'; key facts and history (mission; 'Founded in 2009 by the Electronic Literature Organization (ELO)'; 'Hosted at the Center for Digital Narrative, University of Bergen in Norway'; 'the CELL Element Set metadata standard (2012–2013)' and The Index on 'curated Wikibase and Wikidata infrastructure'; the seven federated member archives by full name); an offer on submitting a database archive or exploring cataloged works. Two cards, both cellproject.net (The Index, About CELL).
